theme.vibe: Calm, evidence-forward, trustworthy, transparent, high-precision escrow ledger with civic accountability

rules.monospaced_strict: ALL BDT amounts (e.g. ৳ 50,000), account IDs (e.g. ACC-8801712-X), transaction hashes, provider names, and ledger entries MUST use font_family_mono with tracking-tight and exact numerical alignment.
rules.bilingual_support: Bangla script must have base text size of at least 15px/16px and leading-relaxed (1.6 to 1.8) for clean conjunct glyph rendering.
rules.heading_scale: H1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight, H2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-semibold, H3: text-xl font-medium, Body: text-base leading-relaxed.

ai_vs_committed_visual_language.committed_facts: Solid 1px or 2px dark border (#0B2B22), crisp white background, clear verified check icon, solid text hierarchy.
ai_vs_committed_visual_language.ai_proposed_items: Dashed stroke (border-dashed border-amber-400 or border-teal-500), subtle tinted background (bg-amber-50/60 or bg-teal-50/40), explicit 'AI Suggested / AI প্রস্তাবিত' pill tag with sparkler icon.

spacing_and_layout.bento_mode: High Density Precision Grid for deal rooms and research profile dashboards
spacing_and_layout.padding_strategy: Generous internal padding (p-6 to p-8) on all bordered cards to prevent text collision
spacing_and_layout.navigation: Top fixed/sticky header with backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 border-b border-slate-200 z-50. Must include Brand Logo, Language Toggle (Bangla ⇄ English), Main Nav Links (Research Hub, Escrow Workspace, Moderation), and User Role Pill.

bilingual_toggle.style: Pill switch with flags/labels (BN / EN), prominent in top header and persistent state in localStorage

deal_room_monitoring.style: Side-by-side split layout: Left side message timeline with version history & counterparty consent locks; Right side live Completion Map (PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN) & BDT Integer Ledger status.
deal_room_monitoring.monitoring_notice: Unambiguous alert banner at top of workspace: 'AI is monitoring this transaction for contractual fulfillment. Human fallback active.'

evidence_forward_chips.style: Every claim in research profiles or dispute complaints must feature a clickable citation chip [Evidence #ID] with direct source preview modal.

honest_states.loading: Skeleton UI with explicit 'Fetching verification logs...' text
honest_states.empty: Structured empty card with actionable 'Submit First Report' or 'Create New Escrow Deal' CTA
honest_states.error: Banner showing exact error reason + Retry button (never pretend success)
honest_states.permission_denied: Lock icon + clear explanation of required role (Buyer / Seller / Reviewer)

hero_and_research.description: Bangladeshi Taka banknotes representing BDT escrow settlement
Public community board and notice lookup
Dual consent signed agreement over paper contract

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, on-distribution outputs (AI slop). Avoid this: create modern, evidence-forward, civic-tech UI with Bengali script elegance.
Do NOT use generic light-purple gradients. Use solid civic emerald (#0B2B22), crisp warm off-white (#FAF9F5), and clean slate containers.
ALL BDT currency values, account numbers, and IDs MUST be monospaced with 'font-mono' and exact integers (e.g., ৳ 12,500).
Visually distinguish AI-proposed draft items (dashed border, light amber background, 'AI Suggested' pill) from committed contractual terms (solid dark border, solid background).
Every claim, dispute item, and research report MUST include an evidence chip/link.
Bilingual toggle (Bangla/English) MUST be accessible globally in the navigation bar.
Honest states everywhere: loading, empty, error, pending, and permission-denied must be explicitly rendered and never masked as success.
All interactive elements MUST include kebab-case `data-testid` attributes for automated testing.
